INTRODUCTION

This vehicle can be equipped with two different climate control systems for the passenger compartment:

- manual climate control

- dual zone automatic climate control

The climate control system makes it possible to vary the specifications of the air introduced into the passenger compartment (temperature, humidity).

The only difference between the two systems described above is in the management of the system:

- With the manually operated climate control system, the user sets the air temperature, distribution and flow rate and they remain like that until they are altered by the user later on.

- On the automatic version, the user can set the parameters and select automatic system management. If they so wish, the user can preseve the facility to manage the system manually. In addition, the automatic climate control system on this vehicle is the dual zone type (driver's zone and front passenger zone), in other words the system has dual controls for the driver and the passenger and is capable of managing the settings for the two users separately, varying the air temperature and distribution parameters (the flow rate cannot be different in the two zones) with a certain degree of independence.

MANUAL CLIMATE CONTROL

The manual climate control system control panel is illustrated in the diagram below.

1 - Vehicle interior air distribution selector knob.

2 - Climate control compressor on/off button.

3 - Air temperature adjustment knob (hot/cold air mixing)

4 - MAX-DEF activation button (front windscreen defrosting).

5 - Air speed selector knob (fan).

6 - Heated rear windscreen on/off button.

7 - Air recirculation on/off button.

The air conditioning is the electrified manual type with the distribution featuring the possibility of shuttering and directing the flows in many ways, thereby guaranteeing an even effect throughout the passenger compartment; the windscreen demisting function is also very efficient. All versions are equipped with a pollen filter and air distribution to the rear passengers.

The manual climate control layout features three rotary controls and 4 buttons.

The left knob allows the adjustment of the distribution, the centre knob allows the adjustment of the temperature and the right knob allows the adjustment of the fan speed.

The panel contains the buttons for switching on the compressor, recirculation, MAX DEF and the heated rear windscreen.

Operating strategy

The manual air conditioning also allows the user to manage the temperature and the intake of air into the passenger compartment using the control knobs.

The following parameters/functions can be altered manually:

- temperature;

- distribution in 5 positions;

- fan speed;

- compressor enablement;

- defrosting/demisting function;

- recirculation.

The automatic climate control system is the dual zone time and offers the possibility of different temperatures and even different air distribution (a feature that confers a high level of comfort on this model).

The automatic climate control is managed by a control unit which is capable, thanks to an extremely refined operating logic, of reaching and maintaining the desired comfort in two zones of the passenger compartment by controlling: the temperature by heating and cooling the air, the air distribution mode inside the passenger compartment and the speed of the fan.

In other words, the climate control system automatically adjusts the following parameters/functions:

- air temperature at the driver's/passenger side vents.

- fan speed (continuous variation).

- air distribution split between driver and passenger.

- compressor engagement.

- recirculation.

The following parameters/functions can be altered manually:

- fan speed.

- distribution in 7 positions.

- compressor disabling

- defrosting/demisting function

- recirculation

Manual selections always take priority over automatic ones and are memorized until the user cancels the command by returning to automatic operation.

The manual setting of a function does not adversely affect the control of the other automatic functions, in particular the temperature control is always automatic when the system is operating.

All the non adjustment buttons are dual (ON/OFF) including the recirculation.

The function is enabled after the button is pressed.

In the dual zone operating mode the user can set two different temperature values for the left and right sides.

It should be pointed out that each time it is switched on the system restores the conditions memorized when it was turned off, except for:

- the MAX-DEF function which is zeroed:

- the recirculation which, with the compressor switched off (by the button or through the low outside temperature) is forced open.

The entire system can be switched off manually (with the fan speed below the minimum value) completely deactivating the air conditioning system. The recirculation is the only function activated: it remains set as before the manual switching off.

Operational status display

The display of the climate control system function status is shown through the LED and the DISPLAY.

- Recirculation function (logo on display): if the button with the profile of the vehicle is pressed, this signals that the recirculation function is on. There is a logo in the display comprising a vehicle with arrows showing the recirculation status (automatic recirculation, recirculation forced closed, recirculation forced open).

- Compressor enablement function (logo on display): if the button with snowflake symbol is pressed, the compressor status is shown on the display.

- AUTO/FULL AUTO (shown on the display, driver's side and passenger side): this signals that all the functions are managed, zone by zone, by the control system. The FULL icon is switched off if there is a distribution, flow rate, recirculation or compressor manual control. The FULL AUTO icon (or AUTO if the FULL was already off) switches off if the system is not capable for manual intervention reasons, of guaranteeing that the temperature set for that zone can be automatically reached/maintained.

- MONO (shown on the display): displays the management of the system in a single zone mode (the temperature and the distribution set on the passenger side is made the same as that set by the driver).

- OFF function (shown on the display): if lit up in the display it indicates that the control unit is off.

- air distribution function (logo in display, driver's side and passenger side): signals the air distribution mode in one of the 7 possible positions (VENT, VENT_DEF, TRI_LEVEL,BI_LEVEL, FLOOR, HEAT and DEF).

- LED for MAX-DEF function: button with yellow LED which, if on, signals the activation of the MAX DEF function.

- HEATED REAR WINDSCREEN function LED: button with yellow LED which, if on, signals the activation of the heated rear windscreen function.

The LCD type DISPLAY shows the passenger compartment fan (A) air flow rate, the temperatures set for the two passenger compartment zones (B1, B2), the status of the compressor (C), the status of the recirculation (D), the system management mode AUTO, FULL AUTO (E1, E2), the air distribution mode (f1, f2), the MONO operation (G) and the switching off of the climate control system (H) by means of bars.

Control of the temperature

Selection of temperature setting

The passenger compartment temperature setting can be applied zone by zone (driver's side and passenger side).

Users can change the temperature settings using the knobs: the left knob is used for the driver's zone and the right knob for the passenger zone.

By turning the knob for the desired zone (driver/passengers) the desired passenger compartment temperature can be increased (clockwise direction) or decreased (anti-clockwise direction).

The increases/decreases are in steps of 0.5 ºC and one complete revolution of the knob produces 12 steps.

The temperature settings are memorized at the key off and then restored at the next key on.

The variation in the temperature range goes from 16°C to 32°C; below 16°C the value set becomes "LO", whilst above 32°C the value set becomes "HI".

Winter starting transition

In order not to create problems for the user, such as blasts of cold air and/misting up of the windscreen, in certain temperature conditions, when the control unit is switched on, the system activates the management of the "WINTER STARTING TRANSITION".

This procedure involves the control unit checking for the existence of the following conditions:

- engine coolant temperature below –4°C;

- outside temperature below 19°C.

If these conditions exist, the control unit launches the "winter transition starting" procedure, setting:

- the air flow rate at the first bar;

- the distribution at DEF;

- the mixture in AUTO conditions.

It is possible, during the winter starting transition, to switch the compressor on automatically to dehumidify the air.

Exit from the winter transition takes place if the outside temperature is above 21°C or if the coolant temperature has reached 50°C.

All the manual functions memorized at the previous key off are restored at the end of the winter transition.

Hi condition

The HI or maximum heating condition is reached by setting a temperature value above 32°C.

This request by the user (driver or passenger) determines the switching off of the FULL AUTO symbol in the display and forces the MONO condition, interrupting any winter starting transition and involving the following actions:

- Compressor: remains as set previously by the user before the HI request

- Mixer: the air mixture flaps are controlled in the ALL HOT position

- Distribution: the distribution flap is in the FLOOR position

- Ventilation: the air flow rate is displayed at a max value of 7 bars equal to 90% (with the limits due to a possible winter transition).

- Recirculation: remains as set previously by the user.

All the manual settings are allowed in the HI condition in accordance with the planned logics: a user request always takes priority over the system automatic regulation conditions.

The AUTO command is accepted, it determines the reset for the HI function and the temperature setting is 32°C for both zones.

If the driver alters the temperature setting, this changes the passenger setting out of HI, (at 32°C).

If the passenger alters the temperature setting, this changes the driver's setting, out of HIGH (at 32°C) altering their own settings and placing the system in the dual zone mode.

The interruption of the HI condition takes place as a result of one of the following priority management functions taking precedence over the maximum hot status management:

- +KEY OFF status management function;

- OFF status management function;

- MAX-DEF status management function.

Lo condition

The LO or maximum cooling condition is reached by setting a temperature value below 16°C.

This request by the user (driver or passenger) determines the switching off of the FULL AUTO symbol in the display and forces the MONO condition, does not prevent any winter starting transition (if planned by the logic) and involves the following actions:

- Compressor: is enabled and the symbol in the display is activated.

- Mixer: the air mixture flaps are controlled in the ALL COLD position

- Distribution: the distribution flap is in the VENT position

- Ventilation: the air flow rate is displayed at a max. value of 7 bars equal to 90%

- Recirculation: remains as set previously by the user.

All the manual settings are allowed in the LO condition in accordance with the planned logics: a user request always takes priority over the system automatic regulation conditions.

The Auto command is accepted, it determines the reset for the LO function and the temperature setting is 16°C for both zones.

If the driver alters the temperature setting, this changes the passenger setting out of LO, (at 16°C).

If the passenger alters the temperature setting, this changes the driver's setting, out of LO (at 16°C) altering their own settings and placing the system in the dual zone mode.

After the LO request, if the compressor is disabled, the symbol in the display flashes and the recirculation is in the forced open position.

The interruption of the LO condition takes place as a result of one of the following priority management functions taking precedence over the maximum cold status management:

- +KEY OFF status management function;

- OFF status management function

- MAX-DEF status management function.

Auto function

Pressing the AUOT button, signalled by the symbols in the display, returns the control of the following functions to the automatic mode:

- Air distribution

- Fan speed

- Compressor

- Recirculation

If the FULL AUTO icon and the compressor enablement symbol are lit up this means that all the above functions are controlled automatically.

If the FULL icon goes out (AUTO signal only present) this means that at least one manual distribution, flow rate, recirculation or compressor movement has been made.

By switching off the compressor as well (snowflake symbol in the display switched off), the system can no longer control/maintain the temperature set by the user.

The temperature reading in the display will appear and flash.

If, at the end of the flashing, the compressor has not been enabled, then the FULL logo (or the AUTO logo only if the FULL logo was already off) will go out .

If the compressor disabling button is pressed, the FULL AUTO logo does not necessarily go out.

To sum up, the difference between the FULL AUTO and AUTO management is that former manages all the climate control parameter automatically whilst the latter only manages the temperature automatically allowing the user to alter the speed of the air and the distribution manually.

Mono function

Pressing the MONO button determines the following action:

- the temperature set on the passenger side is made the same as that set by the driver;

- the distribution set on the passenger side is made the same as that set by the driver;

- the word "MONO" appears on the display.

From that moment the system behaves like a single zone system.

Return to dual zone (and the consequent switching off of the word MON) may take place:

- by pressing the MONO button again;

- by activating the temperature knob set by the passenger;

- by activating the distribution knob set by the passenger;

These buttons remain activated even after susbsequent keys off and keys on.

Fan speed control and display

The air flow rate can be adjusted manually to 8 levels plus switching off, shown on the display by 8 bars.

To increase the fan speed and consequently the air flow rate in the passenger compartment, press the button with the "+" symbol.

Each time it is pressed there is a corresponding increase of one bar.

To decrease the fan speed and consequently the air flow rate in the passenger compartment, press the button with the "-" symbol.

Each time it is pressed there is a corresponding decrease of one bar.

If there have been no manual interventions, the fan speed is controlled continuously by the system and this is shown on the display by the relevant number of bars lighting up according to the flow rate.

At the key on, if the control unit is controlling the air flow rate AUTOmatically, this air flow rate corresponds to the 1st bar (minimum flow rate) until the engine is started.

If the compressor is disabled, the ventilation control can be operated manually until the display shows 1 bar (nil flow rate).

If the compressor is enabled and the engine started, the manual ventilation cannot go below 1 bar (minimum flow rate) shown on the display because with the compressor enabled there must be a minimum air flow rate to prevent the evaporator from freezing.

Air distribution control

There are 7 possible positions for the air distribution (VENT, VENT_DEF, TRI_LEVEL,BI_LEVEL, FLOOR, HEAT and DEF).

In addition to the distribution command, the system displays the position chosen by the various symbols in the display lighting up.

These options can be selected differently by the passenger and the driver.

In AUTOmatic mode the system manages the distribution and does not display its selection (only "omino" remains lit up).

One of the 7 possible positions can be selected manually using the button; each time the button is activated the distribution changes in accordance with the sequence indicated below:

- DEF (ventilation windscreen defrosting/defrosting)

- HEAT (distribution of air flow between footwell vents and windscreen defrosting/demisting)

- FLOOR (footwell ventilation)

- BI_LEVEL (distribution of air flow between footwell vents -hot- and centre and side vents - fresh-)

- TRI_LEVEL (combined distribution of air flow between windscreen vents, centre/side vents and footwell vents)

- VENT_DEF (combined distribution of air flow between windscreen vents and centre/side vents)

- VENT (front ventilation).

Once the last option that can be selected is reached, the system starts again from the first in cyclical mode.

The indications for all the settings mentioned above are valid for both the driver's panel and the passenger one.

Compressor management

The compressor activation button is the dual type. Pressing the button determines the enablement of the compressor on control and the activation of the snowflake symbol in the display.

If the button is pressed again the symbol goes out, the compressor is disabled and the automatic recirculation function is selected if it was closed previously.

Once the button has been pressed, this selection remains memorized indefinitely even after the vehicle has been switched off, the same as for the other manual controls.

The snowflake symbol in the display indicates the physical compressor request status, in other words whether this activation request has been forwarded to the Engine Management Node.

In effect, when the outside temperture is too low, the compressor is automatically disabled for safety reasons and therefore the logo in the display flashes first and then goes out.

When the user manually disables the compressor the word FULL goes out, the control checks whether the system, with the current outside temperature and other parameters, is capable of reaching/maintaining the passenger compartment temperature set by the user:

- If the answer is YES, then the system works normally and is capable of meeting the requirements even without the compressor switched on.

- If the answer is NO, then the system is not capable of meeting the user's requirements and signals this by making the temperature setting figures flash.

If the compressor is not enabled at the end of the signalling, then the AUTO logo will go out and this condition will persist until the compressor is enabled once again.

If it is not enabled again, a flashing cycle will be reactivated at the next keys on.

The AUTO logo will only light up again after the re-enablement of the compressor through that button or the AUTO button.

The flashing system will only be re-initialized after the AUTO logo has come on again.

The flashing, and what follows it, will not take place with the recirculation flap open, forced close or in automatic mode, if the outside temperature is extremely low (< 3°C).

The system will implement the flashing as soon as the outside temperature is above this compressor enablement level.

Recirculation management

Recirculation button

By pressing this button repeatedly, the three possible types of operation are recalled:

- Automatic recirculation

- Recirculation forced closed

- Recirculation forced open

Automatic recirculation

The recirculation is controlled automatically by the system.

Recirculation forced closed

For this type of operation, signalled by the symbol "A" off and the recirculation logo with the arrow on (in the vehicle profile), the closure of the flap in recirculation is signalled.

Recirculation forced open

For this type of operation, signalled by the symbol "A" off, the recirculation LED off and the outside air log with the arrow on (in the vehicle profile), the forced opening of the dynamic flap is signalled.

Max def function

The Max-Def function (MAXimum DEFrost) is a predefined procedure activated by the appropriate button, also managed with the engine off (excluding the heated rear windscreen control).

If the MAX DEF function is activated the following conditions exist:

- Max Def LED lit up

- Memorizing of the function state and previous displays of Max Def control

- Switching off of logos for FULL AUTO and recirculation functions.

- Word MONO lit up

- Compressor enablement , recirculation open, HEATED REAR WINDSCREEN and MONO

- Display of the max hot temperature (HI) on both the display side figures

- Display of the ventilation in the display

Activation of the following controls in the climate control:

- Air flow rate 80% of the max flow rate

- Distribution flap in Def position

- Mixture flaps in Max Hot position

- Air intake flap forced open (dynamic)

- Compressor function enabled

- Rear windscreen defrost function

On leaving the MAX DEF function te first useful selection for Mixture, Flow rate and consequently Distribution is implemented.

The MAX DEF procedure last 3 minutes starting from when the temperature of the engine coolant exceeds the winter transition exit level.

During the operation of the MAX-DEF it is possible to:

- Alter the air flow rate (up/down) at will.

- Deactivate the heated rear windscreen.

It is not, however, possible to:

- alter the temperature setting (driver/passenger)

- alter the distribution setting

- alter the recirculation setting.

The MAX DEF function can be interrupted by activating any one of the climate control system control unit buttons/controls (Max-Def, air distribution or temperature) causing a return to the condition prior to the MAX DEF except for the control for the button that was pressed and has to be implemented.

The management of the MAX DEF procedure takes priority over the management of the LO (maximum cold) and HI (maximum hot) procedures which, if in progress, are interrupted if the MAX DEF procedure is activated.

The rear defrosting is implemented both with the appropriate button pressed and through the MAX DEF procedure.

The display of the function state takes place through the relevant LED switching on/off.

The function requesting the activation of the heated rear windscreen is only subject to the presence of the key-on.

The HEATED REAR WINDSCREEN function is not memorized at the key-off.

Switching off the control unit/system (off)

Pressing the "ventilation -- button" in succession switches off the control unit when the number of ventilation bars is equal to 0. This conditions determines the following actions:

- memorizing of the current state

- switching on the OFF indication

- forced air recirculation closed and lighting up of logo in the display (vehicle profile with recirculation arrow)

- fan excluded

- compressor excluded

- mixer in max cold position

- distribution in Vent

- in the OFF state the Heated Rear Windscreen button is managed normally without activating the climate control system.

In OFF the recirculation button operates in dual mode (ON/OFF) opening and closing the flap without managing the automatic operation of the AQS (pollution control).

Pressing any button afterwards (except the heated rear windscreen, recirculation or temperature) switches the system back on, activates the function requested, if it wasn't previously (otherwise it confirms et) and restores all the other operating conditions that the system memorized previously.

When exiting from OFF, the recirculation returns to Automatic mode.
